verdict.rationale: Ironclad provides generic contract creation (no-code builder), approval workflows, and e-signature collection (docs-9,10,38) that could technically be used to draft and route a board consent/resolution document for approval and signature, but there is no evidence of board-consent/resolution templates, cap-table or equity-specific workflows, or any legal-ops-specific corporate governance feature. missing for 10: board consent/resolution templates, equity-fundraising-specific workflow examples, evidence of actual customer use for corporate governance documents.
